item.title: Embedded Software (Firmware)
item.description:
Firmware Engineering

Writing scalable and clean firmware code using vendor APIs (HAL/LL), building real-time apps with FreeRTOS, and handling cellular/Wi-Fi wireless communication via MQTT protocol.

item.title: Enclosures & Prototyping (Mechanical)
item.description:
Mechanical Design & Physical Assembly

How you bridge the gap between electronics and physical products. Importing Altium STEP files into Fusion 360, rendering, 3D printing (FDM/SLA) prototypes, component hand-soldering, and final assembly stress tests.

item.title: PCB Design & Electronics (Hardware)
item.description:
Hardware Development Approach

Description of your schematic capture and PCB routing workflows using Altium Designer and KiCad. Preparing clean production packages including Gerber files, BOMs, and Pick&Place assets.
